text: M M L U spread multiple-choice questions across dozens of subjects. Its Pro version made the choice sets bigger and the questions harder. It cleaned up ambiguous questions, too. The authors compared answering directly with working through the problem first. Working it through helped more on the new test. G P Q A brought in subject experts to write questions a quick search couldn't settle. Humanity's Last Exam screened submissions against strong models. Some of the questions that survived even need a picture.
speaker: Ryan
